subject: RRO 3.2.1 uninstall  leaves  R 3.2.1 unusable [ /usr/bin/R  gone ]

messages.author: ec1f049e809f38cb
messages.subject: RRO 3.2.1 uninstall  leaves  R 3.2.1 unusable [ /usr/bin/R  gone ]
parts:
Hello,

In a previous post I related the issues when installing RRO 3.2.1 on opensuse 13.2 [ 64bit] .
At RRO installation time, on that machine R 3.2.1 was installed and worked fine.
Because RRO did not start on Opensuse [ due to libicu @ 53.1 instead of 52.1],  I uninstalled RRO via yast2.

Trying to use R 3.2.1 I got a message that /usr/bin/R is not available/found .
RRO uninstall wiped /usr/bin/R and orfaned the CRAN installation  because /usr/lib64/R/bin/R  is a symlink to /usr/bin/R .

I had to upgrade/[re]install  R-base and other R packages to have /usr/bin/R re-installed .

The RRO solution of altering the CRAN R product is not the best one  .
RRO should not change other products , RRO should solve its problems by itself.
What about creating /usr/bin/RRO  instead of   altering /usr/bin/R ?

Hopefully a solution is implemented .

Thank you,
Nick

messages.author: b92b0e53baf64e49
messages.subject: Re: RRO 3.2.1 uninstall  leaves  R 3.2.1 unusable [ /usr/bin/R  gone ]
parts:
Hi Nick,

Thank you for your report. We will investigate the uninstallation issue. However, please note that RRO is not currently supported on openSUSE 13.2.  For a list of supported platforms please see here: https://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/#review

Thank you,

Josée Martens
